protocol.user_authorization: Verify multi-training-seed stability of full-data beta=.25 three-epoch AS-JEPA; if stable pursue valuable Lingjing experiments, otherwise investigate and improve within the same model size; use dev2/dev13/dev15, stop unneeded work, commit and push new conclusions.
protocol.model_size_policy: Identical to frozen seed0 model; verify model_size.json for every replication; no batch-level regularizer or calibrated initialization added.
protocol.planning_protocol: P0: CEM300x30, horizon5, history3, goal offset25, budget50, FP32/highest, compile=false; same heldout episode split and paired start/goal cases.

stability_decision.description: Practical predeclared screening criteria, not a formal population guarantee. Assess new training seeds1-4 separately from selected seed0, and all five seeds descriptively.
stability_decision.confirmation: Report fresh evaluation seeds without tuning on them; inconsistent confirmation prevents a stable conclusion.
stability_decision.ambiguous: Inspect cases, planner repeat noise and at most two further prespecified seeds before declaring success or choosing an improvement; preserve every result.

early_stop_policy.numerical: Stop nonfinite training; preserve checkpoints and diagnose; no automatic repeated retry.
early_stop_policy.primary_replications: Retain complete three-epoch budgets for finite, nonempty models, even when early planning is weak.
early_stop_policy.persistent_collapse: Stop only after >=11000 consecutive zero-active-dimension updates plus independent noisy-posterior failure on two completed checkpoint audits; report as early-stopped failure, not a completed final score.
early_stop_policy.other_work: Old completion_20261028 plan remains held. Do not launch old full grids,20-epoch or capacity extensions just to occupy GPUs.

conditional_followup.stable: Select decisive Lingjing controls such as the distant-anchor ablation and matched LeWM objective; prioritize information gained per GPU-hour.
conditional_followup.unstable: Diagnose complete successful/failed seeds first; prioritize matched I03 temporal posterior noise and I05 forecast rendering, alone and together, with unchanged model size and sample-level objectives; extend research/theory only as evidence warrants.

protocol.publication: Commit and push every useful new conclusion with full numeric results and scientific PNG/SVG; datasets, weights, logs, checkpoints and raw media remain under EFS.

collapse.forward_precision: BF16 autocast; Gaussian rate and pose errors FP32; highest FP32 matmul

limits: A practical stability screen over four new training seeds is not a formal population guarantee.
Seed0 was selected using historical results; new seeds1-4 are reported separately.
Evaluation seeds are paired test conditions, not independent training replications.
Confirmation uses the same heldout episode split, not a new dataset.
This reproduces three-epoch intermediate checkpoints under a ten-epoch LR schedule, not the full original benchmark.
No human gallery signoff or equal-budget LeWM superiority is inferred.
